top_choice_rationale: P003 most clearly links a defined pathogenic cytokine mechanism to decisive clinical proof of a durable disease-modifying treatment principle. Feldmann and Maini are a focused proposed pair, while the citation can be confined to establishing TNF blockade rather than later products, indications, or implementation; detailed priority review remains necessary.
recusal_note: No candidate-specific conflict is apparent from the supplied profile. My documented research in autoimmunity and rheumatology concerns related disease areas but does not establish a personal connection to Feldmann, Maini, or any other proposed candidate.
